question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH user_ages AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        birth_date,
        CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year,
        2017 - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age
    FROM mst_users
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN age >= 20 AND age <= 29 THEN '20s'
        WHEN age >= 30 AND age <= 39 THEN '30s'
        WHEN age >= 40 AND age <= 49 THEN '40s'
        WHEN age >= 50 AND age <= 59 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_category,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM user_ages
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY 
    CASE age_category
        WHEN '20s' THEN 1
        WHEN '30s' THEN 2
        WHEN '40s' THEN 3
        WHEN '50s' THEN 4
        WHEN 'others' THEN 5
    END
